method.contentReview: Reviewed the current stem, four options, keyed index, explanation, subtopic, difficulty, and sourceId for all 300 in-scope questions; answer-key and distractor findings are limited to high-confidence, unambiguous defects.

method.mergeCheck: Compared each in-scope retained object with its matching object in the regenerated merged bank and checked the merged bank count and ordering.

highConfidenceFindings.recommendedAction: Add the inspected edition/year and local PDF path or stable URL to the catalog entry, retaining the existing sourceId unless the underlying source changes.

conclusion: The current technology and holistic retained files pass schema, answer-index, source-ID resolution, syllabus, coverage-count, duplicate, option-length-threshold, repair-log, and merged-bank correspondence checks.
